title: CEDAR · The woman who was a tree
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: A woman at the mill's old gate who remembers the year she was a cedar: the ring she was, the saw, the truck, the kiln. She tells it to the dog. The page draws her in cutaway like the ridge, rings inside her, one ring marked. The dog believes her. So does the page.
